newsitem.title: CHINA: U.S. expects China to fulfill commitments on HK.
newsitem.headline: U.S. expects China to fulfill commitments on HK.

text.p: U.S. Vice President Al Gore said on Wednesday that the United States expected China to live up to its commitments on Hong Kong after the transfer of power on July 1.
"We expect China to honour its commitments," he told a news conference.

The Sino-British accord reached in 1984 calls for the capitalist system and structure of the booming territory to remain unchanged for 50 years after the British colony reverts to Chinese sovereignty at midnight on June 30.
Gore told reporters that Beijing should live up to its obligations for a high degree of autonomy for Hong Kong after the handover to ensure a smooth transition.

China has already said it would dismantle Hong Kong's elected legislature and scrap many of its laws on civil liberties after the handover, in a move that has raised an outcry from political activists in Hong Kong.
